shortDescription: Enable or disable the Windows Firewall

options.name: inbound_action
options.description: Set to C(allow) or C(block) inbound network traffic in the profile. C(not_configured) is valid when configuring a GPO.

options.name: outbound_action
options.description: Set to C(allow) or C(block) inbound network traffic in the profile. C(not_configured) is valid when configuring a GPO.

options.name: profiles
options.description: Specify one or more profiles to change.

options.name: state
options.description: Set state of firewall for given profile.
